# Stenmont

> The agentic business kit for test-network USDT payments, invoices and connected records. Payers bring their own USDT; Stenmont does not fund wallets. Full reference: https://app-staging.stenmont.com/llms-full.txt

Facts an agent needs:
- API: https://api-staging.stenmont.com. Server-side Authorization: Bearer $STENMONT_API_KEY; never put credentials in a browser, repository or chat.
- Persist an Idempotency-Key with the order before a checkout attempt; reuse it on retries.
- Verify the raw webhook body with Stenmont-Signature and STENMONT_WEBHOOK_SECRET, then bind the stored invoice ID, amount and paid status before atomic fulfilment.
- Connect: https://app-staging.stenmont.com/dashboard/connect; finish only after its four checks pass.
- SDK and React packages are not published. Use HTTP until publication is explicitly approved.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs): Connect a server-side checkout and verify signed payment webhooks.
- [API reference](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/api): Authentication, invoices, errors and idempotent requests.
- [MCP and OAuth](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/mcp): Connect scoped agents using OAuth with PKCE and draft-only tools.
- [SDK and React](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/sdk): Use the server SDK and a checkout link in React.
- [Webhook reference](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/webhooks): Verify raw-body signatures and fulfil each paid order once.
- [x402 payments](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/x402): Price agent requests and settle authorized test USDT payments.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://app-staging.stenmont.com/docs/faq): Test-network payments, payer funding, agent permissions and records.
